summary.text: Zebulon Featherly, an independent candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 1st District to Jack Bergman.
A northern Michigan native, he has worked as an electrician and wind turbine technician and described his campaign as outside the party system.

paragraphs.text: Featherly was born in Houghton, Michigan, and earned a high school diploma from Houghton High School.
He attended Eastern Michigan University and graduated from the North Western Renewable Energy Institute in 2017.
Featherly has worked as an electrician and wind turbine technician. In his Ballotpedia survey he describes himself as an apprentice electrician who was born and raised in northern Michigan.
He received 0.2% of the vote to Jack Bergman's 53.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
